Offered report producer filenames never choose paths for reads; post-replay report pin maps are checked as subsets of the fixed trusted closure.

Invalid or unsupported requests refuse. The API compares valid pairs only and defines neither malformed-output/abstention denominators nor a corpus accuracy score.
Whole-comparison validation requires an independent full canonical output pin followed by exact regeneration through the same public APIs.
